tools.name: newsman_list_lists
tools.description: All email lists (and SMS lists) this key can access, each with list_id, list_name and list_type. Start here: most other tools need a list_id. GET /v2/list/all.

tools.name: newsman_get_list
tools.description: Properties of one list: sender name and email, owner contact details, site, link parameters, send rate. The list secret is never returned. GET /v2/list/getProps.

tools.name: newsman_count_list_subscribers
tools.description: The number of active (subscribed) subscribers of a list. GET /v2/list/count.

tools.name: newsman_list_subscribers
tools.description: Subscribers of a list with a given status (subscribed, unsubscribed, bounced, spam, inactivated), optionally only those who joined since a UTC date. Each item has subscriber_id, email and the date of that status. Paged (page from 0, up to 1000 per page). GET /v2/list/getSubscribers.

tools.name: newsman_get_list_growth
tools.description: Daily evolution of a list: total and eligible subscribers, unsubscribes, spam reports and hard bounces per day. Give `days` (last N days) OR start_date/stop_date; the period is at most 90 days. GET /v2/list/subscribersEvolution.

tools.name: newsman_search_subscribers
tools.description: Search the subscribers of a list by keywords (email or name) and status, optionally only those who joined since a UTC date. Paged (page from 0, up to 1000 per page). GET /v2/subscriber/search.

tools.name: newsman_get_subscriber
tools.description: One subscriber of a list by email address: status and dates, name, IP, custom properties and segments. GET /v2/subscriber/getByEmail.

tools.name: newsman_get_subscriber_by_id
tools.description: One subscriber by subscriber_id: status and dates, name, IP, custom properties and segments. GET /v2/subscriber/get.

tools.name: newsman_get_subscriber_history
tools.description: The last 100 actions of a subscriber: subscribe, unsubscribe, send, view, click, bounce, spam, each with a date and metadata (newsletter, link). GET /v2/subscriber/history.

tools.name: newsman_list_segments
tools.description: The segments of a list with segment_id, segment_name, subscriber count and status (0 idle, 1 import running, 2 counting, 3 searching). NewsMAN allows 20 calls a minute for this method. GET /v2/segment/all.

tools.name: newsman_count_segment_subscribers
tools.description: The number of active subscribers in a segment. GET /v2/segment/count.

tools.name: newsman_list_segment_subscribers
tools.description: The subscribers of a segment (subscriber_id and email). Paged (page from 0, up to 1000 per page). GET /v2/segment/getSubscribers.

tools.name: newsman_list_newsletters
tools.description: Newsletters (campaigns) of a list with newsletter_id, subject, status, dates, segments and headline stats. Filter by status (-1 cancelled, 0 new, 1 confirmed, 2 sending, 3 paused, 4 resumed, 5 sent; or a comma list such as 1,5; default all), by creation date range, or the last N days. Paged. GET /v2

tools.name: newsman_get_newsletter
tools.description: Properties of one newsletter: subject, sender, status, dates, segments, links to the online view. Long HTML is clipped. GET /v2/newsletter/getProps.

tools.name: newsman_get_newsletter_stats
tools.description: Delivery and engagement stats of one newsletter: sent, views, clicks, unsubscribes, bounces, spam reports and rates. GET /v2/newsletter/stats.

tools.name: newsman_get_newsletter_clicked_links
tools.description: The links clicked in one newsletter with the number of clicks and the last click time. GET /v2/newsletter/linksClicked.

tools.name: newsman_list_automations
tools.description: Automation workflows of a list with workflow_id, name, type, status (0 inactive, 1 active), version and stats. Filter by name, status and last-updated range. GET /v2/automation/all.

tools.name: newsman_get_automation
tools.description: One automation workflow: name, type, status, version, recurrence, stats and preview links. GET /v2/automation/getWorkflow.

tools.name: newsman_get_automation_stats
tools.description: Daily stats of the automations of a list: sends, opens, clicks, purchases, bounces, unsubscribes. Optionally for given workflows and a period (last N days, or start_date/stop_date; at most 90 days). GET /v2/automation/stats.

tools.name: newsman_get_import_status
tools.description: Status of a background subscriber import by import_id: new, running, finished or error, with times and the last error. GET /v2/import/status.

tools.name: newsman_subscribe_email
tools.description: WRITE: subscribe an email address to a list (or update it if it exists), with optional name and custom properties. A property key with the tag_ prefix sets a tag. Only use for people who gave consent. The subscriber is active at once, with no confirmation email. Returns the subscriber_id. POST /v2/s

tools.name: newsman_unsubscribe_email
tools.description: WRITE: unsubscribe an email address from a list, so it no longer receives campaigns from that list. Returns the subscriber_id. POST /v2/subscriber/saveUnsubscribe.

tools.name: newsman_update_subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: change the email, first name or last name of a subscriber. Give only the fields to change; the others are left as they are. POST /v2/subscriber/update.

tools.name: newsman_add_subscriber_tags
tools.description: WRITE: add tags to a subscriber (existing tags stay). POST /v2/subscriber/addTags.

tools.name: newsman_add_subscriber_to_segment
tools.description: WRITE: add a subscriber to a (static) segment. POST /v2/subscriber/addToSegment.

tools.name: newsman_remove_subscriber_from_segment
tools.description: WRITE: remove a subscriber from a segment (the subscriber stays on the list). POST /v2/subscriber/removeFromSegment.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "newsman_get_list" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Properties of one list: sender name and email, owner contact details, site, link parameters, send rate. The list secret is never returned. GET /v2/list/getProps…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: newsman_list_lists, newsman_get_list, newsman_list_subscribers, newsman_search_subscribers, newsman_get_subscriber, newsman_list_segment_subscribers, newsman_get_newsletter, newsman_subscribe_email, newsman_unsubscribe_email, newsman_remove_subscriber_from_segment · Private data: newsman_get_list · Public sink: newsman_list_lists, newsman_get_list, newsman_list_subscribers, newsman_search_subscribers, newsman_get_subscriber, newsman_get_subscriber_history, newsman_list_segment_subscribers, newsman_subscribe_email, newsman_unsubscribe_email, newsman_update_subscriber, newsman_add_subscriber_tags, newsman_add_subscriber_to_segment, newsman_remove_subscriber_from_segment · Destructive: newsman_remove_subscriber_from_segment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: newsman_list_lists, newsman_get_list, newsman_list_subscribers, newsman_search_subscribers, newsman_get_subscriber, newsman_list_segment_subscribers, newsman_get_newsletter, newsman_subscribe_email, newsman_unsubscribe_email, newsman_remove_subscriber_from_segment · Private data: newsman_get_list · Public sink: newsman_list_lists, newsman_get_list, newsman_list_subscribers, newsman_search_subscribers, newsman_get_subscriber, newsman_get_subscriber_history, newsman_list_segment_subscribers, newsman_subscribe_email, newsman_unsubscribe_email, newsman_update_subscriber, newsman_add_subscriber_tags, newsman_add_subscriber_to_segment, newsman_remove_subscriber_from_segment · Destructive: newsman_remove_subscriber_from_segment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
